entities.summary: University of Gladzor was a medieval Armenian university, one of the two "great centres of learning" along with the University of Tatev that were "essentially of a single tradition." It was established around 1280 by Nerses of Mush, a student of Vardan Areveltsi, and operated until 1340 and "left behind a rich intellectual heritage".
